author: GitHub
description:
Stop guessing which AI model to use for your coding tasks. In this episode of GitHub Checkout, Julia Kasper joins to break down Project HydraFusion - a new approach to multi-model orchestration in the GitHub Copilot CLI. Learn how HydraFusion evaluates your intent and automatically routes prompts through single, cascade, or critique execution patterns. Try it today by turning on experimental mode in the Copilot CLI, GitHub Copilot App or Vs Code with /experimental. 

HydraFusion is live in GitHub Copilot CLI: https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/206492

— CHAPTERS —  

00:00 Introducing Project HydraFusion 
00:50 How to Use HydraFusion Today 
01:34 HydraFusion vs. Auto Model Select 
02:58 HydraFusion's Smart Execution Strategies 
03:59 Deep Dive: Single, Cascade, Critique 
06:10 Efficiency Demos: HydraFusion in Action 
09:31 Transparency and Avoiding User Bias 
12:05 What's Next for HydraFusion? 
13:59 Try HydraFusion and Share Feedback 
 
#GitHub #GitHubCopilot #ProjectHydra
title: Inside Project HydraFusion: multi-model orchestration in the GitHub Copilot | demo | GitHub Checkout
